newsitem.title: USA: Mellon boosts dividend, sets stock split.
newsitem.headline: Mellon boosts dividend, sets stock split.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said it said a two-for-one stock split and raised its common dividend by 10 percent to $0.66 a share on a pre-stock split basis.
The dividends are payable on May 15, 1997 to shareholders of record at the close of business on April 30, 1997.
The stock split is being structured as a stock dividend of one additional share of common stock being paid on each currently outstanding share of common stock.

The shares will be distributed on June 2, 1997 to shareholders of record at the close of business on May 1, 1997. On post-stock split basis, the corparotion's quarterly dividend will be $0.33 a share.
